title: Remove login button and replace smmourprice logo with IBAZEX logo

requirements.summary: Remove the login button from the Header component across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: Login button is no longer visible in the Header component
No authentication UI elements remain in the header
Navigation remains functional without login functionality

file_operations.description: Remove the LoginButton component and its import from the Header. Remove any authentication-related UI elements (user profile display, login/logout buttons) from the header navigation while preserving the navigation links to home, services, and admin pages. Maintain Arabic RTL layout and existing styling.

requirements.summary: Remove the smmourprice logo from all components where it appears
acceptanceCriteria: All references to smmourprice logo are removed from the codebase

file_operations.description: Remove all references to the smmourprice logo image (generated/smm-ourprice-logo.dim_400x400.png) from the Header component. Remove the logo img element and any associated links or wrappers.

Remove all references to the smmourprice logo image (generated/smm-ourprice-logo.dim_400x400.png) from the Hero component. Remove the animated logo display and any associated styling or animation classes.
Remove all references to the smmourprice logo image (generated/smm-ourprice-logo.dim_400x400.png) from the Footer component. Remove the logo img element from the IBAZEX branding section.

requirements.summary: Add IBAZEX logo in place of the removed smmourprice logo in Header, Hero, and Footer components
acceptanceCriteria: IBAZEX logo displays in the Header component
IBAZEX logo displays in the Hero section
IBAZEX logo displays in the Footer component
Logo styling is consistent with the existing design

file_operations.description: Add the IBAZEX logo using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/ibazex-logo.dim_200x60.png in the Header component. Position the logo appropriately for navigation bar usage, maintaining the existing header layout and Arabic RTL support. Apply appropriate sizing and styling to match the header design.

Add the IBAZEX logo using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/ibazex-logo-hero.dim_400x120.png in the Hero section. Position the logo prominently in the hero area with appropriate sizing and animations that match the existing hero design. Maintain the transparent background support and ensure the logo is visually prominent.

Add the IBAZEX logo using the generated image at frontend/public/assets/generated/ibazex-logo.dim_200x60.png in the Footer component's branding section. Style the logo consistently with the footer design and ensure it displays properly with the Arabic RTL layout.
